title: Computer lab classroom with instructor at front and rows of desktop monitors
objects_and_counts: At least 1 person standing or positioned at the instructor lectern at the front of the room (near the projector screen).
At least 14 seated people are visible in the classroom audience (students facing the front); some heads are partially obscured by monitors or other students.
At least 12 individual desktop monitors are visible in the photographed scene; many are arranged in rows on student workstations and several are partially cropped by the image frame.
1 large projection screen is visible at the front of the room with a projected slide displayed.
1 laptop computer (open) is visible in the foreground on the right side of the image with a visible application window on its screen.
Multiple desktop PC towers or monitor bases are visible beneath monitors on the desks (at least 6 clearly visible units), but some are obscured so a full count cannot be determined.
Multiple student chairs are visible across the rows (at least 10 distinct chairs can be seen).

Various small items on desks are visible such as a water bottle at left, a mouse pad and mouse near the foreground laptop, and personal items near students, but these are transient and not exhaustively counted.
spatial_relations: The instructor is at the front-center of the room in front of the projection screen and behind a lectern or instructor desk.
Rows of student workstations with desktop monitors face the front projection screen; monitors create multiple visual rows that partly obscure seated students behind them.

A blue door or pair of blue doors is visible on the right side of the front wall (image right), with notices or papers posted adjacent to the door; the projection screen is mounted on the left side of the front wall (image left).
The foreground laptop is on a desk near the bottom-right of the image in front of a seated student; a desktop monitor stands directly behind that laptop on the same desk surface.
Student seating is arranged in parallel rows running from the foreground toward the projection screen at the back of the photographed room.
colours_and_materials: The projection screen area and front wall are light-colored (off-white or pale), and the ceiling tiles are white with recessed fluorescent lighting.
Most monitor casings and PC towers visible are black or dark grey.
Chairs visible have dark blue seats with a perforated or patterned plastic appearance.
A pair of blue doors is visible on the front-right wall (image right).
Students wear a variety of clothing colours; one student in the middle-right wears a bright red top that stands out against surrounding colours.
uncertainties: No exact room name or room number signage is legible in the photograph; location cannot be determined from visible text.

Many small labels, stickers on monitors, printed notices on the blue door and text on the projected slide are not legible at this resolution; only the single word 'Note:' could be read on the projection.

Counts of monitors, PC towers and chairs are minimum visible counts because several devices are partially obscured or cropped by other objects and people; a full room inventory cannot be determined from this single image.
Text on the instructor's clothing, monitor stickers, wall notices and door postings is unreadable or too small to transcribe accurately.
The projected slide contains multiple lines and boxed elements but the detailed content beyond the word 'Note:' is not legible in this image.
